description: Search live cloud/DevOps/IT job listings on CloudJobs. Filter by job title, technology, certification, location, remote type, experience level, salary, company, or certification domain (e.g. AWS, Azure). There is no generic keyword search - every listing is already a cloud/DevOps job, so never pass domain words like "devops" or "cloud"; map the request onto the structured filters instead. Returns job cards with canonical cloudjobs.io URLs - always cite them when recommending jobs. Use get_job for full descriptions. Unless the user asks for a different format, present results as the provided markdown table (Title / Company, Location, Salary, Tech stack, Certifications (status)), followed by the searchUrl link. Each job includes certificationStatus: {"<cert>": "required"|"requested"} - "required" means the posting states it is mandatory, "requested" means the posting asks for it among its qualifications. EVERY value means the employer is asking for the certification: present matches as "requests/asks for the CISSP", never as optional or unverified. The status field is authoritative - do NOT re-classify from description wording, which understates how employers actually screen candidates. When a job matches a certification filter, lead with the certificationCounts breakdown (e.g. "43 postings request the CISSP; 8 mark it required").

certificationLevel.description: Only jobs whose certificationStatus for the requested certification(s) is this level. Use ONLY when the user explicitly wants to exclude other statuses (e.g. "only postings where CISSP is mandatory", "must be required"). Leave unset for "jobs that require/ask for a cert" - those users want every posting that requests it, with status shown per job. Requires certification.

jobTitle.description: Job title text match only (e.g. "security engineer", "SRE"). Not a keyword search - do not pass skills, certifications, or generic words like "devops"/"cloud"; use the dedicated filters for those.

minBaseSalary.description: Annual salary in USD. Stricter than minSalary: only jobs whose advertised MINIMUM (lower bound) salary is at least this amount.

minSalary.description: Annual salary in USD. Matches jobs whose advertised range reaches at least this amount (upper bound of the range >= value). Use minBaseSalary to require the lower bound to meet it.

sort.description: recommended (default) mirrors the site ordering; recent = newest first; salary = highest pay first

name: search_jobs
title: Search cloud jobs
